caption:
Your pipeline has three lead types.

You're giving them equal effort.

Ready now. They decided before they called. A fast, clear confirmation closes it.

Persuadable. Your largest group. Speed and persistence close these deals. Pitch quality plays a small role.

Never. Wrong budget, wrong timing, wrong fit. No cadence changes that.

Most owners chase the never group out of guilt, let the persuadable group go cold, and take the ready-now wins for granted.

Pull your last 20 leads. Sort them into the three buckets. Count how many persuadable leads got only one follow-up before going quiet.

See your pipeline sorted automatically.

DM TRIAL

#SpeedToLead #LeadFollowUp #ServiceBusinessOwner #CRMforContractors #BusinessGrowth
rationale: Carousels still lead 2026 B2B saves and depth, and this three-bucket lead segmentation model is a genuinely unclaimed framework for allocating follow-up effort, distinct from every prior stage, ladder, matrix, decay-curve, lead-debt, triage, and scorecard model already shipped.
